reviews.comment: The emerald meenakari detailing and pearl drops look genuinely heirloom quality. Sits comfortably without pinching.
Wore this for my sister’s sangeet. Zero tarnish and arrived in a velvet travel box.
Stunning kundan shine, slightly heavy for very long ceremonies but balanced well by the silk dori.
Featherlight despite the ornate bell carving. Dual-tone finish pairs with both silver and gold sarees.
Exact filigree texture as shown in the zoom gallery. Secure push backs.
Matte gold finish is tasteful and not brassy. Size 2.6 fits true to Indian bangle measurements.
Loved the polki cuff piece, great value for the full stack.
Rich garnet shade and soft mulmul lining inside. The organza dupatta drapes like a dream.
Clean zari embroidery with zero loose threads. True to size M.
Crisp handloom linen that stays breathable through Mumbai summers. Tailoring is sharp.
Easily fits a large phone and lipstick. The braided pearl handle elevates any festive outfit.
Subtle champagne zari sheen works wonderfully over workwear shirts and kurtas alike.
